description: This file is a PHP source file containing utility functions for serializing, storing, and retrieving data with integrity checks in the SuiteCRM project. It defines constants, performs file operations, and manages data serialization with security considerations.

methods.name: suite_file_put_serialized_contents
methods.description: Serializes data, appends a hash for integrity, and writes it to a specified file.

methods.name: suite_file_get_unserialized_contents
methods.description: Reads serialized data from a file, verifies its integrity, and unserializes it.
